stories.hook: Con bach tuoc co 3 trai tim.
stories.body: Nhung do khong phai dieu ky la nhat. Mau cua no trong xanh vi dua tren dong, khong phai sat nhu con nguoi.
stories.payoff: Va no co the tu cat 1 canh tay de thoat hiem, roi moc lai canh moi.

stories.hook: Dung co nghi den con gau trang ngay bay gio.
stories.body: Ban vua nghi roi dung khong? Do la ironic process theory. Nao cang co ngan cam, cang lam dieu do xuat hien.
stories.payoff: Bi quyet that su: dung tranh no. Hay thay the bang 1 suy nghi khac.

stories.hook: Trai tim con ca voi xanh to bang 1 chiec xe hoi.
stories.body: Nhung no dap chi 8 lan 1 phut. Cham den muc ban co the nghe thay tu 3km duoi nuoc.
stories.payoff: Va dong mach cua no rong den muc 1 nguoi co the boi qua.

stories.body: Trong 8 giay do, nao ban tao ra 1 the gioi ma ban khong he biet. Do la luc ban mo.
stories.payoff: Nhung neu ban thuc day trong luc mo, ban co the dieu khien duoc giac mo. Goi la lucid dreaming.

stories.hook: Ca map gia hon cay coi.
stories.body: Ca map xuat hien truoc cay xanh 150 trieu nam. Chung song sot qua 5 cuoc dai tuyet dien.
stories.payoff: Va moi nam chung thay 30.000 rang. Ca doi co the thay 50.000 cai.

stories.hook: Ban chi co the co 150 nguoi ban that su.
stories.body: Do la so Dunbar. Na boc cua ban khong the xu ly nhieu hon. Vuot qua, ban bat dau quen.
stories.payoff: Nhung trong 150 do, chi 5 nguoi that su quan trong. Ban dang lang phi thoi gian cho ai?

stories.hook: Kien co the nang gap 50 lan trong luong co the.
stories.body: Neu con nguoi manh nhu kien, 1 nguoi co the nang 1 chiec xe tai.
stories.payoff: Nhung kien khong co phoi. Chung tho qua nhung lo hong tren co the. Do la ly do chung song duoc moi noi.

stories.hook: Moi nguoi deu co 1 phan toi.
stories.body: Do la shadow self theo Jung. Nhung gi ban ghet o nguoi khac, thuong la thu ban khong dam thua nhan o chinh minh.
stories.payoff: Khi ban chap nhan no, ban khong con bi no dieu khien nua.

stories.body: Khong phai theo cach huyen bi. Nhung phan tu nuoc lien ket voi nhau, tao thanh 1 mang thong tin khong lo.
stories.payoff: Co the cua ban cung vay. 60% cua ban la nuoc dang ghi lai moi thu.

stories.body: Khi 1 con qua chet, dan qua tu tap lai. Chung khong chi thuong tiec. Chung dang dieu tra.
stories.payoff: Neu chung thay nguoi gay ra cai chet, chung se ghi nho khuon mat do suot doi.

stories.hook: Choi game co the thay doi cach ban nhin the gioi.
stories.body: Sau khi choi Tetris nhieu, nao ban tu dong ghep cac vat the thanh hang. Goi la Tetris effect.
stories.payoff: Dieu nay co nghia: ban co the "cai dat" nao minh bang cach lam 1 viec lap di lap lai.

stories.body: Do la mui thuoc sung va bot da chay trong khong khi. Khi nguoi dat buoc len, mui nay bam vao do.
stories.payoff: Cac phi hanh gia noi rang no giong mui thubet sung sau khi ban.
